card: SEO-4 — exchangethb.com Ratchada page CTR + professional SEO round 2
prerequisite: SEO-1 release card 3816d481 (done, verified by fujane 10:5x); this card did not touch the shared dirty workspace

baseline_source.note: Reused the SEO-1 export; no new GSC export was pulled, so the before/after split is 09-18..10-15 (before) vs anything after the 11:22 release (after).

query_baseline.query: รัชดาเอกเช้น

diagnosis.primary: Top-10 ranking with a 0.12% CTR is a snippet problem, not a ranking problem (seo-audit: position 1-5 with weak CTR => title/description only).
secondary: The Thai page answered Thai queries with an English-Latin title and a one-line provider blurb as its description, so the Thai brand query รัชดาเอกเช้น got zero clicks at position 9.
The page led with a template headline and had no answer-first opening, no original per-provider content, 2 FAQ entries and no LocalBusiness/FinancialService markup.
The three money changer profiles were reachable only from the noindex hub, the four route guides and the sitemap; /cash (the site's second-largest indexed page) had no link to them.

files.change: new: provider facts derived from data/site.ts (hours parser, address precision, geo), 3-locale meta/answer/FAQ copy, LocalBusiness+FinancialService JSON-LD builder, 10-locale hours formatter

rewritten: answer-first lead, today's observed rate block, localized hours/area, three-changer comparison (table >=sm, cards on mobile), 7-entry FAQ, FAQPage + BreadcrumbList + exchange JSON-LD, brand-first metadata
new: link strip on /cash to the three profiles (10 locales, localised hours/status, direct /en link for locales that would otherwise 307)
renders the strip between the picker and the guide
.seo-changers* styles matching the existing light .seo-* block
assertions for the 3 profiles in en/th/zh, the /cash strip, and the localized (not raw English) hours line on /ja/cash; 68 checks
new: 14 tests (hours parser vs data/site, brand-first meta, 40-60 word lead, unique per-provider copy, FAQ parity, JSON-LD address/geo/hours rules)

not_touched: rates / fees / affiliate logic and values

before_after_structure.before: eyebrow + H1 + one-sentence summary + open status + map/official/compare buttons + a rate card + location card + 2 FAQ entries + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage + FinancialService (no address/geo/hours spec)
before_after_structure.after: eyebrow + H1 (+Thai brand line) + 40-60 word answer + status pills + CTAs + today's observed rate with observation time + location card (area/address/hours/Sunday) + 5 currency rows + three-changer comparison + per-provider differentiators + 7 visible FAQ entries + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage + LocalBusiness+FinancialService with PostalAddress/GeoCoordinates/openingHoursSpecification

programmatic_template.playbook: programmatic-seo — Profiles playbook, 3 pages, facts generated from data/site.ts, copy hand-written per provider
anti_thin_rules_applied: every page has a hand-written lead paragraph and 2-3 provider-specific differentiators, so the three pages are not swapped variables
the comparison table carries same-collection observed rates, so each page shows a different highlighted row

unique facts per page: Ratchada = 7 days + verified street address + own rate page; SuperRich Thailand = Pratunam area only + closed Sunday + branch chosen on official site; Twelve Victory = head office + different weekday/weekend hours + no coordinates in our records
JSON-LD only emits what data/site.ts holds: no postal address for SuperRich Thailand (area-level note) and no geo for Twelve Victory (null coordinates)
tests enforce unique answers/positioning and fact parity (tests/money-changer-seo.test.ts)

route_301_decision.decision: keep the 301 redirects; do not re-enable the pages
reasoning: seo-audit says pick one owning page per query cluster and check cannibalization first. /cash is already the owner of the cash-comparison cluster and receives these three URLs' signals; restoring 3 of the 23 retired aliases re-splits the cluster that the 2026-10-07 consolidation deliberately joined.

The restored pages would be template route guides (title/intro/audience/checks from lib/route-guides.ts) — the same thin shape that made the other 20 aliases redirect. seo-audit warns that thin locale/template pages drag site-wide quality; on a 71-URL site that is a real risk for a 64-impression gain.

Re-enabling needs four coordinated policy changes (middleware, lib/indexing-policy.ts, app/sitemap.ts 71 -> 74+, scripts/check-seo-cluster.mjs) and would also require Thai route indexing, which the policy has never allowed. That is a bigger change than this card's evidence supports.

/th/routes/asok... earns 20 impressions with 0 clicks at position 10.7; the Thai traffic this card can win is the brand query รัชดาเอกเช้น (97 impressions), which the new Thai title/description now targets directly.
The redirects are 301 (permanent) and their targets are already the most relevant pages (/th/cash for Thai, /en/cash?currency=EUR for the Europe intent), so no signal is being lost.
route_301_decision.revisit_rule: Reconsider only if a single route URL exceeds ~100 impressions / 28 days at position <=10 with a query set distinct from /cash, and then restore it as a real guide with area-specific content (branches, hours, addresses) rather than template prose.
